events.verdict: Thompson (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in Hart's (NYK) path before releasing away to the basket.
Anunoby (NYK) appears to brush Thompson's (HOU) arm, but any contact that occurs has no effect on his dunk attempt.
Hart (NYK) firms up over to his right foot in Thompson's (HOU) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Sengun (HOU) briefly grasps and releases Hart's (NYK) jersey during the rebound.
Towns (NYK) and Sengun (HOU) engage and disengage in the post, allowing each other to move freely.
Brunson (NYK) is late to the spot while defending Green (HOU) on the perimeter, but the contact does not affect Green's SQBR.
Brunson (NYK) places his forearm against Green's (HOU) body as he returns to the floor but the contact does not affect his ability to follow through or land safely.
Eason (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position during Brunson's (NYK) drive to the basket and shot attempt and the contact is incidental.
Thompson (HOU) engages with Towns (NYK) but the ball is out of Towns' reach and the marginal contact does not affect his ability to pursue the rebound.
Brunson (NYK) places a hand to Brooks' (HOU) side as he takes a long dribble and the marginal contact does not affect his control of the ball.
Hart (NYK) moves forwards into Thompson's (HOU) space, initiating body contact that affects his shot attempt near the basket.
Brunson (NYK) loses control of the ball after driving into Thompson (HOU), who is moving alongside of his path to the basket and the contact is incidental.
